title: Rule 605 Publication Composer
description: Rule 605 publication composer over caller-declared best-ex/669-shaped inputs: the effective-vs-quoted spread ratio (eq_ratio, 2dp half-up), the covered-order roll-up echoes, and a publication-row builder for declared categories. Declared inputs only: covered orders, covered shares, and spread statistics are your declarations, never observations this page makes; it reads no market data, tape, venue, or order-management system. PUBLICATION_ROWS_BUILT is a composition verdict, not an obligation assessment. Absent or invalid inputs fail closed and are named. Rounding is 2dp half-up. No network, no storage, no clock.

orders_covered.description: Declared count of covered orders, integer in [1, 1000000].

shares_covered.description: Declared count of covered shares, integer in [1, 1000000000].

avg_effective_spread_bps.description: Declared average effective spread, finite number in (0, 10000] basis points.

avg_quoted_spread_bps.description: Declared average quoted spread, finite number in (0, 10000] basis points.

declared_categories.description: Optional declared category names (1 to 50 non-empty strings of at most 80 characters); one publication row is composed per category.
